proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Write U = Spec(k); for a field extension k'/k with U' = Spec(k') and R' the restriction of R, set Z' = Z times_R R' and W' = R' times_R W. For a point xi = (z, w) of Z times_{s, U, t} W with r the image of z in R, the explain-points lemma provides k' and r' in R' over r; one can choose z' in Z' mapping to z and r', and then a point xi' of Z' times_{s', U', t'} W' mapping to z' and xi. The open c(r', W') of R' (move-point lemma) is contained in the image of Z' times_{s', U', t'} W' to R'; the displayed identification of Z' times W' with the base change of Z times_{s, U, t} W along R' times R' inside R times R shows the image of Z' times W' to R' to R lands in the image of Z times_{s, U, t} W to R; and R' to R is open (restrict-groupoid-on-field lemma). Hence the image of Z times_{s, U, t} W to R contains an open neighbourhood of the image of each xi, i.e. it is open. (source lines 1416-1436)

core_obligations: Setup: U = Spec(k); for a field extension k'/k take U' = Spec(k'), R' the restriction of R, Z' = Z times_R R' and W' = R' times_R W; fix a point xi = (z, w) of Z times_{s, U, t} W and let r be the image of z under Z to R (proof lines 1417-1421). Lifting: by lemma-groupoid-on-field-explain-points pick k' and r' in R' over r; choose z' in Z' over z and r'; then a point xi' of Z' times_{s', U', t'} W' exists mapping to z' and xi; the open c(r', W') of R' from lemma-groupoid-on-field-move-point lies inside the image of Z' times_{s', U', t'} W' to R' (proof lines 1422-1428). Conclusion: the identification Z' times_{s', U', t'} W' = (Z times_{s, U, t} W) times over (R times_{s, U, t} R) with (R' times_{s', U', t'} R') shows the image of Z' times W' to R' to R lands in the image of Z times_{s, U, t} W to R; R' to R is open by lemma-restrict-groupoid-on-field, so the image of Z times_{s, U, t} W to R contains an open neighbourhood of the image of xi; as xi was arbitrary the image is open (proof lines 1429-1435).
proof_roadmap: Fix an arbitrary point xi of the fibre product and lift it along a suitable field extension using explain-points (proof lines 1417-1426).
Cover the lifted point by the open translate c(r', W') inside the restricted image (move-point lemma) (proof lines 1426-1428).
Push down along the open map R' to R using the fibre-product identification to get an open neighbourhood inside the original image (proof lines 1429-1435).
